score: Mean correlated gain versus the best held fixed allocation in each replica. Worst independent drift versus target-only. The known-law allocation and forecast are evaluator references.
method: Unlabeled calibration assigns weights to a discrete joint grid of donor contrast, target contrast and shift agreement. A cohort chooses its allocation by Bayes expected Brier gain under the full posterior. All nonoracle arms use the same joint predictor. Known-law arm is evaluator-only. Fresh seeds and simulator families; equal eight-probe budget; one target outcome scored and kept out of training. This diagnostic makes no native or scientific superiority claim.
